_target_note: triggers.py defaults the target to the PACKAGE id, which is abstention-threshold-design-v2. The skill's frontmatter name is abstention-threshold-design - the -v2 lives on the build, not on the unit - so scoring against the package id counted 0 of 12 positives as no-fires when the router had in fact chosen the skill every time. Corrected here, by hand, and recorded rather than silently fixed.
